 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 10 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You have been consistently working towards something, and finally you may be feeling like you are tired. Taurus , if something sucks the life out of you, either it is not meant for you,u or you may be better off altering your approach to the situation. Instead of remaining chained to your ideas about how things should be and how perhaps life has panned out instead, cherish where you are today. If you only look at the wonderful place you are already in and take a brief moment to acknowledge that, Leo , you will feel more in charge of your life. Your decisions lately may have been survival-based—like, if you don't move, how will things happen? Or that your past efforts will go in vain. But really, you have an idea which needs time, patience and consistent effort to show up. Capricorn , if you just take a step back, you will realise that it is not that you are not worth it or that your efforts have gone to waste. It is simply that, just as it's quicker to imagine a picture than to actually paint it—your manifestations and visions may feel more accessible in thought than in reality, only because in our 3D world, energy takes a bit of time to take form and shape. Don't second-guess yourself.
 Read on for what the stars have in store for you, and make sure you check out your sun, moon and rising signs for the complete picture.
 Aries Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) If the glass is feeling half empty, it may be time for you to take a second look, Aries . You are here, sitting by your fireplace, like a warm marshmallow, comfortable in your life on the whole, and you are also looking for ways to grow, expand, devise new plans to either stabilise your wealth and resources or to make more money or feel generally more stable and secure in life. There is something about ancestors, genetics, family patterns or inheritances that may have been on your mind or playing out in your life. Keep your heart open and clean and your head in the right place—the cosmos has your back.
 Cosmic tip: Get honest, stay accountable for your actions and accept fairness.
 Taurus Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You have been consistently working towards something, and finally you may be feeling like you are tired. Taurus , if something sucks the life out of you, either it is not meant for you, or you may be better off altering your approach to the situation. Instead of remaining chained to your ideas about how things should be and how perhaps life has panned out instead, cherish where you are today. This is the place many crave to be in. And no, that is not why you must go on, but this is what you could remind yourself so that you can gain some objective clarity on things.
 Cosmic tip: Look where you have handed your power over to your circumstances and then reclaim it back to yourself.
 Gemini Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) While you may have been busy and merry in your own sweet world, Gemini , you may feel like you suddenly got a jumpstart. It's almost like driving in your own lane with no one in sight on a wide road and then boom! Suddenly you have someone come at youhead-onn! Just remember to press the brakes and not the accelerator. Take a break, slow down and most importantly remember to not take this as defeat. There will be a time when you will find that super-enthusiastic self surface once again, but sometimes, you need to put your head on the pillow for a bit so you can take a cat nap.
 Cosmic tip: You don't always lose when you snooze.
 Cancer Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You feel, and you feel deeply, Cancer , and that is not your falling. It is your strength and greatest power. You may have been reviewing two or more roads that are lined up ahead of you. And you may have been striving to keep going because you feel if you don't, someone else will. But remember now, Cancer, life is very different! You are very different. And no, you don't need to race at someone else's pace to get somewhere. You simply need to pause to take a look at your own garden and see which plants are thriving. These are the skills that hold potential, the ideas that hold promise and the efforts that are likely to reap rewards. They may come easy to you, or you may have worked very hard for them—either way, the more you remember to stay in your lane, the faster your track gets.
 Cosmic tip: It's time to go-go-go.
 Leo Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) If you only look at the wonderful place you are already in and take a brief moment to acknowledge that, Leo , you will feel more in charge of your life. Your decisions lately may have been survival-based—like, if you don't move, how will things happen? Or that your past efforts will go in vain. But really, you have an idea which needs time, patience and consistent effort to show up. Now the question is: are you going to take the steps that may probably feel like sloth speed to you right now but in actuality will take you forward, or are you going to keep making haphazard movements just to feel productive?
 Cosmic tip: True strength lies in visionary action.
 Virgo Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your family, tribe and community are the pride of your life—the legacy and empire you are building and leaving behind. Now, Virgo , with that clearly set in place, you are also in a space where you can demarcate right from wrong and see through situations that most people cannot. Stay anchored, stay flexible, yet stay in as much awareness of your inner compass as possible, with a dash of surrender to the cosmos. You are levelling up.
 Cosmic tip: Keep moving towards your goals.
 Libra Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Life has been busy lately, with lots of activity, perhaps even social commitments and a probable movement on your work front as well. Libra , keep the momentum going, one steady step ahead of another. You will find resources, support and assistance that will propel you forward at a faster speed—soon! And at that point in time, you will feel like you've quantum jumped. For now, all you are to focus on is making these blessings and this movement feel like a normal part of your life—that's how you create space for more goodness to flow through.
 Cosmic tip: Turn what's in your heart into what you are holding in your hand.
 Scorpio Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Why the rush? Scorpio , you have decided to take it as it comes, to make your own waves and surf them too. You were probably blessed with a fantastic opportunity or resource on the work or personal front, and honestly, you did the best you could. You used your mental agility and foresight to plan and strategise to the best of your ability, and now here you are reaping the rewards. Keep your foresight in focus and keep making decisions that feel best for you.
 Cosmic tip: Humbly accept your blessings without guilt or obligation towards anyone.
 Sagittarius Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You feel like an emperor or empress sitting on a throne—you have your high chair, and you are enjoying the comfort and view this brings along. Sag , this is the time to take a stance, to make a decision and to keep following what your foresight, intuition and gut have been relaying to you on repeat. The world will continue to keep trying to sway you, but as long as you remember your goals and keep focusing on them, stay present in your life while building what you envision —you are golden.
 Cosmic tip: Base your choices on what you feel is right for you. Stay humbly confident in yourself.
 Capricorn Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may be feeling trapped in your own mind and may have been running around in circles over the same things over and over again. Capricorn , if you just take a step back, you will realise that it is not that you are not worth it or that your efforts have gone to waste. It is simply that, just as it's quicker to imagine a picture than to actually paint it, your manifestations and visions may feel more accessible in thought than in reality, only because in our 3D world, energy takes a bit of time to take form and shape. Don't second-guess yourself. Keep your focus steady. You are on track.
 Cosmic tip: Instead of waiting on absolute certainty, take tiny steps that lead you forward.
 Aquarius Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) What feels like crumbs right now are the very steps that lead you to greener pastures in the near future. Aquarius , wear your thinking cap, and get your Mary Kondo-like organising superpowers on! You are one who loves focusing on the details. Now you don't need to fall into the trap of perfection; you simply need to stack those ideas, schedules and plans in bite-sized, achievable ways. Soon you will have your precious stash ready, and your eyes will be left gaping at how it all came together so beautifully.
 Cosmic tip: Row the boat towards the shore—this is the last leg of choppy-ish waters for you.
 Pisces Horoscope Today: November 10, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may have been stalking your goals and your desires, Pisces . And honestly, it seems like you feel wound up in your own head—caught between the devil and the deep sea. But only you aren't! The challenge is not that there is no solution. The challenge feels like you may need a dash of patience in the mix, and you may have been running out of it. Your intuition led you down a road, and you expected instant results. But balance is what this world is built on. Things will arrive when they are ready, and their readiness also depends on your ability to hold your vision and keep your calm. Bite through this dilemma and pour your heart into whatever you are working towards.
 Cosmic tip: Let your heart and sense of purpose create the butterfly effect you are waiting for.
